name: CXTailor Funnels
author: cxtailorik

sections.description:
CX Tailor is a modern no-code customer journey builder that lets you create interactive experiences, video funnels, multi-step flows and branching paths without any technical skills.

This plugin connects your WordPress site directly to your CX Tailor workspace, enabling you to embed and manage all your journeys easily inside WordPress. Every update you make in CX Tailor can instantly appear on your WordPress pages, creating a fast, seamless and highly efficient workflow.

Key features of CX Tailor

  • No-code journey creation – Build customer journeys visually without writing a single line of code.
  • Interactive CTAs – Add call-to-action buttons inside the journey flow.
  • Smart surveys – Use simple questions to personalize the visitor experience.
  • Branching paths – Create dynamic, choose-your-own-path journeys.
  • Multi-step & video funnels – Combine steps, videos and guided flows to increase engagement.
  • A/B testing – Compare different journey versions to optimize conversions.
  • Human-readable analytics – Understand visitor behavior with intuitive reporting.

Plugin capabilities

  • Connect your WordPress site to your CX Tailor account
  • Manage and update journeys without leaving the WordPress dashboard
  • Embed any journey using Gutenberg blocks or shortcodes
  • Instantly reflect updates made inside CX Tailor
  • Remove the need for repetitive back-and-forth editing between platforms

CX Tailor helps you create meaningful, conversion-focused user experiences—and this plugin brings that workflow directly inside WordPress.

External services

This plugin connects to the CX Tailor service (https://admin.cxtailor.com) to authenticate users and to fetch and embed funnel/workspace data.

Data sent:
– When the user logs in via the plugin: the email and password are sent to https://admin.cxtailor.com/auth/login to obtain an authentication token.
– When embedding or viewing funnels/workspace data: the plugin may send the workspace ID and the authentication token to fetch data from the CX Tailor API endpoints (for example /api/data/workspaceData/{workspaceId}).
– When embedding funnels: the plugin loads an external script from https://admin.cxtailor.com/cxtailorfunnel.js and may load embedded content from https://admin.cxtailor.com/sharedFunnel/{id}?embed=true.

Why:
– Authentication and data retrieval are required for the plugin to function and to display the selected funnels/content.

sections.installation:
Install through the WordPress Dashboard

  1. Open Plugins → Add New
  2. Search for “CXTailor Funnels”
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate

Or install manually

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  3. Upload the ZIP and click Install Now, then Activate

Connect WordPress with your CX Tailor account

  1. After activation, go to CXTailor in the WordPress admin menu
  2. Enter your CX Tailor email and password
  3. Save the settings to connect to your workspace

Embed your customer journey

  1. Create or edit a page or post
  2. Insert the CX Tailor Funnels block from the block editor
  3. Select the journey you want to embed
  4. Publish the page

Your interactive journey will now appear on your WordPress site.
sections.faq:
Do I need a CX Tailor account to use this plugin?

Yes. The plugin communicates directly with your CX Tailor workspace.

Can I edit my journeys inside WordPress?

No. All editing happens inside CX Tailor. The plugin syncs and embeds journeys into WordPress.

Do changes in CX Tailor update automatically on my site?

Yes. When you publish updates in CX Tailor, they immediately appear on your embedded journeys.

Do I need any coding skills?

No. CX Tailor is fully no-code.

Is A/B testing supported?

Yes. A/B tests can be created and managed from inside the CX Tailor platform.

Does CX Tailor include analytics?

Yes. CX Tailor provides clear, human-readable analytics that show how visitors move through your journeys.

How do I embed a journey?

Use the CX Tailor Funnels block or paste the shortcode generated in your CX Tailor dashboard.
